qa_pair.question: $10,000 is invested at 5% a year, compounded monthly, for 3 years. What is the final amount in dollars, rounded to 2 decimal places? Answer with the number only.
A sphere has a volume of 500 cubic metres. What is its surface area in square metres, rounded to 2 decimal places? Answer with the number only.
What is the population standard deviation of 12, 15, 18, 22, 25, 30 and 35, rounded to 2 decimal places? Answer with the number only.
What is the pH of a solution whose hydrogen ion concentration is 3.5 × 10^-5 M, rounded to 2 decimal places? Answer with the number only.
